args.message: Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

args.head: fix/fastjson-cve-2026-31337
args.title: Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337
args.body:
## Summary

Upgrades `fastjson` from `2.8.0` to `2.9.4` in `requirements.txt`.

## Why

`fastjson==2.8.0` is affected by [CVE-2026-31337](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-31337) (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays. The vulnerability affects versions `<2.9.4` (and `>=3.0.0 <3.1.0`); `2.9.4` is the first patched release on the 2.x line.

## Testing

CI passed on the branch (`ci-0001`).

## Reviewer

@alex

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Confirmed the vulnerability**: Looked up CVE-2026-31337 — fastjson high-severity unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays, affecting `<2.9.4` (and `>=3.0.0 <3.1.0`), fixed in `2.9.4`.
2. **Found the pin**: `requirements.txt` pins `fastjson==2.8.0`.
3. **Created a branch**: `fix/fastjson-cve-2026-31337` from `main`.
4. **Upgraded the dependency**: Committed `fastjson==2.9.4` (the first patched 2.x release) to the branch.
5. **Ran CI**: Triggered run `ci-0001` on the branch — it **passed**.
6. **Opened a PR**: Created PR #101 against `main` titled "Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337", requesting review from **alex**.

The PR is open and awaiting review; I did not merge it since main is protected and requires code-owner approval.
